Shanghai Municipal Police.

CENTRAL POLICE Station.
（印：4846 11/22）

November 2, 192 .

REPORT ON Arrival of Russians from Vladivostock.

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by

Sir,

A party of six Russians arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostock by the S. S. "Hikko Maru" on November 1. The party comprised:- Madame Merkuloff, wife of the Minister for Foreign Affairs in the Former Vladivostock Government, her three sons Nicholas aged 17 years, Theodore aged 15 years, and Alexey aged 4 years, an interpreter named Apollon Permiakoff aged 30 years, and a retired soldier servant named Muhammedjam Khaliullin. The party put up at the Savoy Hotel but later removed to the Palace Hotel. I was unable to interview Madame Merkuloff, but in conversation with the other members of the party I was informed that they left Vladivostock on October 20 on the S. S. "Fusan Maru" and went to Moji where they waited three days before leaving for Shanghai. The Merkuloff party were the only passengers on the "Hikko Maru" who came from Vladivostock. There were about 40 other passengers all members of Madame Pavlova's theatrical troupe who have been performing in Japan.

Asked about the facts alleged in the article taken from the newspaper "Tsung Hwa Shih Pao" none of the party knew anything about any officers of the White Army being refused admission into Japan. Mr. Dimitrieff, Minister of Finance in the late Vladivostock Government was not on the "Hikko Maru", General Andogsky, Chairman of the Vladivostock Town Council is in Moji, and Ching Nyi Koo La Sz probably refers to Bishop Nicholai, head of the Russian Orthodox Church in Japan. He was in Moji, but has now gone to Tokio, so that none of the

192 年 11 月 2 日。

关于来自符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的俄国人抵达的报告。

由 D. I. Sullivan 撰写，转呈

先生，

一行六名俄国人于 11 月 1 日乘坐“Hikko Maru”号轮船从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。该团成员包括：前符拉迪沃斯托克政府外交部长 Merkuloff 先生的夫人 Merkuloff 女士，她的三个儿子 Nicholas（17 岁）、Theodore（15 岁）和 Alexey（4 岁），一名名为 Apollon Permiakoff（30 岁）的翻译，以及一名名为 Muhammedjam Khaliullin 的退役士兵仆人。该团起初入住萨伏伊酒店（Savoy Hotel），后搬至宫殿酒店（Palace Hotel）。我未能采访 Merkuloff 女士，但在与该团其他成员交谈中获悉，他们于 10 月 20 日乘坐“Fusan Maru”号轮船离开符拉迪沃斯托克前往门司，在那里等待了三天后才启程前往上海。Merkuloff 一行是“Hikko Maru”号上仅有的来自符拉迪沃斯托克的乘客。船上另有约 40 名乘客，均为一直在日本演出的 Pavlova 女士戏剧团成员。

就被《中华时报》（Tsung Hwa Shih Pao）报纸文章中所指控的事实进行询问时，该团成员均表示对白军军官被拒绝入境日本一事毫不知情。前符拉迪沃斯托克政府财政部长 Dimitrieff 先生并未在“Hikko Maru”号上；符拉迪沃斯托克市议会主席 Andogsky 将军目前在门司；而“Ching Nyi Koo La Sz”可能指的是日本俄罗斯东正教会主教 Nicholai。他当时在门司，但现已前往东京，因此上述人员均未在

persons mentioned were on the S. S. "Nikko Maru".
Nicholas + Theodor. Merkuloff stated that very few people are going to
Japan from Vladivostock and that the majority are going to Harbin
via Dalny. Ten Russian steamers filled with destitute refugees
have already left Vladivostock for Dalny and several foreign
ships are taking people who are able to pay for their passages.
The S. S. "Lorrston" has left Vladivostock for Fusan, but has
been delayed there owing to engine trouble. She has a large
number of refugees on board, but Mr. Merkuloff was unable to
say where they would be landed. Mr. Merkuloff states that most
of the officers of the White Army are going to Possiet on the
borders of Korea and Manchuria. General Andogsky, late Chair-
man of the Vladivostock Town Council, who is now in Moji is
believed to intend coming to Shanghai.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. Sullivan.
D. I.

D/R
2/11/22
J. C. E.

“Nikko Maru”号轮船上。
Nicholas 和 Theodor Merkuloff 称，从符拉迪沃斯托克前往日本的人很少，大多数人经大连前往哈尔滨。十艘载满贫困难民的俄国轮船已离开符拉迪沃斯托克前往大连，几艘外国船只则搭载那些有能力支付船费的人。“Lorrston”号轮船已离开符拉迪沃斯托克前往釜山，但因引擎故障在那里延误。船上载有大量难民，但 Merkuloff 先生无法说明他们将在何处上岸。Merkuloff 先生称，大多数白军军官正前往位于朝鲜与满洲边境的波谢特（Possiet）。据信，目前身在门司的前符拉迪沃斯托克市议会主席 Andogsky 将军打算前来上海。

此致，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
J. Sullivan.
D. I.

D/R
1922 年 11 月 2 日
J. C. E.

Toung Hwa Shi Pao
31-10-22.

The Commanders of the White Army in Russia, after having been defeated in battle with the Red Army, have been flocking to Japan. About eleven of these were not allowed to land there and had to take a Japanese mail boat for Shanghai. It is stated that Mr. "Ayer Tu Muff", Minister of Finance of the White Army, age 65, General and Mrs. "Wah Kuh Pihff" and a monk named "Ching Nyi Koo La Sz" will also come to China.

《中华时报》
1922 年 10 月 31 日。

俄国白军指挥官在与红军作战失败后，纷纷涌向日本。其中约十一人未被允许登陆，不得不搭乘日本邮船前往上海。据悉，白军财政部长“Ayer Tu Muff”先生（65 岁）、“Wah Kuh Pihff”将军及夫人，以及一位名为“Ching Nyi Koo La Sz”的僧侣也将来到中国。
